name: hero-highlight
title: Hero Highlight
description: A full-width dark panel covered in a faint dot grid, wrapping a headline, copy and an inline phrase marker. Moving the pointer lights a small patch of coloured dots under it.
use: A marketing hero wants a quiet dotted texture with a spotlight that tracks the pointer.
avoid: It needs mouse movement, so the coloured dot patch never appears on touch, and text over the dots needs care.
a11y: The dot spotlight only reacts to the mouse and the sweep ignores reduced-motion; the dotted texture has no text alternative. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black full-width panel covered edge to edge in a faint dotted grid. A large white headline sits centred, with one phrase set on a lilac-to-purple rounded swipe, and a small grey line of copy beneath.
behaves: The dot grid stays still until the pointer moves, then a soft 200px patch of brighter indigo dots follows the cursor. The phrase swipe fills its gradient in from the left once on load.
customise: Put your headline and copy as children; a className styles the content wrapper and containerClassName the panel. Dot colours and the 200px spotlight radius are fixed in the file.
weight: light: SVG dot layers and a masked gradient following the pointer; no canvas loop.
demo: Headline 'Build beautiful products...' and a line about a curated component library.
issues: White letters on the pale lilac half of the phrase swipe are hard to read.
The cursor dot spotlight is too faint to notice in the recorded frames.
polishWhy: Crisp type and a neat dot field; the phrase swipe is low contrast and the cursor effect faint.
